<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1902784_refund.RefundCurrencyConverter</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RefundCurrencyConverter</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CurrencyConverter = Class.create();
CurrencyConverter.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    getUsdRate: function() {
        try {
            var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('FreeCurrencyAPI', 'Default GET');
            var response = r.execute();
            
            if (response.getStatusCode() == 200) {
                var obj = JSON.parse(response.getBody());
                // Usamos o parseFloat para garantir que o retorno seja um número decimal
                return parseFloat(obj.data.USD).toString(); 
            }
        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error("Erro na integração: " + ex.message);
        }
        return "0"; // Retorna zero como string se falhar
    },

    type: 'CurrencyConverter'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-30 11:24:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>a06e83f983e4c35027aba6d0deaad3e4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>RefundCurrencyConverter</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Refund" source="x_1902784_refund">7ef79c0d83240f1027aba6d0deaad34c</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Refund">7ef79c0d83240f1027aba6d0deaad34c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a06e83f983e4c35027aba6d0deaad3e4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-30 11:50:30</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
